title.zh: 为什么计算一直在等内存

desc.zh: 处理器每秒能算上千万亿次，为什么运行起来却常常大部分时间都在等内存？十个交互模型带你从五级流水线、缓存模拟器、矩阵分块、内存墙与利特尔法则，一路走到屋顶线模型、大模型推理和 HBM4 前沿。
desc.en: Processors can execute quadrillions of operations per second, yet spend most of their time waiting for memory. Ten interactive models trace the bottleneck from a 5-stage pipeline and set-associative cache to tiled matmul, Little's Law, the Roofline model, LLM inference, and HBM4.

desc.zh: 五级流水线每拍完成一条指令，但一旦遇到等内存的数据相关，后续指令只能停顿吐气泡。
desc.en: A 5-stage pipeline retires one instruction per cycle until a memory-latency hazard fills the pipe with stall bubbles.

zh: 取指 译码 执行
AI 芯片为什么大部分时间都在等
en: why does an AI chip wait

title.en: Memory Latency Hierarchy and Cache Locality

desc.zh: 从 L1 到 DRAM 慢了约 80 倍；因为硬件按缓存行搬运，按行遍历与按列遍历矩阵的流量可差 8 倍。
desc.en: DRAM is roughly 80x slower than L1 cache; because hardware fetches full cache lines, row-major vs column-major matrix walks can differ by 8x in traffic.

zh: 按行遍历 按列遍历
为什么二维数组按行更快

title.zh: 矩阵分块与时间局部性

desc.zh: 同样做 2N³ 次乘加的矩阵乘法，把小块锁进缓存能减少近十倍慢内存搬运，分块过大溢出缓存又会恶化。
desc.en: Matrix multiplication does the same 2N^3 ops, yet cache-sized tiling cuts slow memory traffic nearly 10x while oversized tiles thrash capacity.

zh: 为什么同样 O(N^3) 速度差十倍

title.en: The Memory Wall and Little's Law

desc.zh: 哪怕只有 2% 的缓存缺失也会拉低一半以上有效算力；要吃满高速总线，在途并发数据必须等于带宽乘延迟。
desc.en: Even a 2% miss rate cuts effective compute more than half; saturating a fast memory bus requires concurrency equal to bandwidth times latency.

title.zh: 多核扩展、阿姆达尔与总线瓶颈
title.en: Multicore Scaling, Amdahl, and Bus Contention

desc.zh: 登纳德缩放结束后靠多核扩展，但串行比例（阿姆达尔定律）和共享内存总线很快把加速比封顶。
desc.en: After Dennard scaling ended, more cores hit serial bottlenecks (Amdahl's law) and shared memory bus saturation.

zh: 为什么多核不能线性加速

desc.zh: GPU/TPU 用大量并发线程掩盖延迟，并通过脉动阵列让权重驻留片上反复复用。
desc.en: GPUs and TPUs trade per-thread latency for massive warp concurrency and systolic arrays that reuse weights on-chip.

zh: 为什么 AI 用 GPU 不用 CPU

title.zh: 屋顶线模型与算术强度
title.en: The Roofline Model and Arithmetic Intensity

desc.zh: 可达性能等于峰值算力与（带宽 × 算术强度）中的较小者；算术强度越过屋脊拐点才算吃满算力。
desc.en: Attainable performance is min(peak FLOP/s, bandwidth x arithmetic intensity); only past the ridge point is a workload compute-bound.

zh: 内存受限 算力受限

title.zh: 大模型推理的内存瓶颈

desc.zh: 自回归解码每吐一个字就要读取全部权重与 KV 缓存，单批算术强度约 1 FLOP/B；量化与批处理用于提高重用。
desc.en: Autoregressive LLM decode reads all weights and KV cache per token (~1 FLOP/B at batch 1); quantization and batching shift the bottleneck.

zh: 为什么推理吃显存带宽

title.zh: 数据搬运能耗与 HBM 封装
title.en: Data Movement Energy and HBM Packaging

desc.zh: 从片外 DRAM 读取数据的能耗是浮点加法的几百倍；HBM 靠极短极宽的硅中介层连线降低距离与能耗。
desc.en: Fetching a word from off-chip DRAM costs hundreds of times more energy than adding it; HBM stacks dies on a wide interposer to shorten wires.

zh: 为什么 HBM 这么贵

title.zh: HBM4、共封装光学与算力前沿
title.en: HBM4, Co-Packaged Optics, and the 2026 Frontier

desc.zh: 2026 年末 AI 芯片迈向 2048-bit HBM4 与共封装光学，同时 PIM 与神经形态硬件仍在与生态和成本博弈。
desc.en: Late-2026 hardware pushes toward 2048-bit HBM4 and co-packaged optics while PIM and neuromorphic chips face area and software hurdles.

title.zh: 诊断芯片与程序的四个问题
title.en: Four Questions for Any Chip or Slow Program

desc.zh: 用步长局部性、算术强度、在途并发和芯片外边界四个问题快速定位性能瓶颈。
desc.en: Locate performance bottlenecks using four checks: stride locality, arithmetic intensity, in-flight concurrency, and off-chip boundaries.

zh: 怎么看 AI 芯片参数
